6cf2bee4fc5e1541.en: The letter was sent on {{sent}} and registered on {{registered}}. It is not a tax return and does not confirm transfer of money.
6cf2bee4fc5e1541.zh: 信件于{{sent}}发送，{{registered}}登记。它不是纳税申报表，也不能证明已转账。

0392ef326137c499.en: Д-1 was submitted on {{declaration}}, Д-2 on {{amended}}. The letter was sent {{sent}}, received {{received}} and registered {{registered}}.
0392ef326137c499.zh: Д-1于{{declaration}}提交，Д-2于{{amended}}提交。信件于{{sent}}发送、{{received}}收到、{{registered}}登记。

a63578fab7ee6ee5.en: An amended return was submitted before the earlier review ended; the new review period is linked to Д-2. The base case had one original return. Here a new review is linked to an accepted amended return, not an additional letter.
a63578fab7ee6ee5.zh: 更正申报在此前核查结束前提交，新核查期限与Д-2相关。基础案例只有一份原始申报。本案新核查由已受理的更正申报引起，而不是补充信。

559ad54acb67aab4.en: An amended return was submitted before the earlier review ended; the new review period is linked to Д-2.
559ad54acb67aab4.zh: 更正申报在此前核查结束前提交，新核查期限与Д-2相关。

496f5d2ca245a3b8.en: Any subsequent return has no effect on an unfinished original review.
496f5d2ca245a3b8.zh: 任何后续申报均不影响尚未结束的原始核查。

7bd41ef33345df46.en: Every letter to reception starts another three months of review.
7bd41ef33345df46.zh: 每封寄给接待处的信都会重新启动三个月核查。

b1fa887938a297c8.en: A correct document name does not compensate for the wrong starting event.
b1fa887938a297c8.zh: 文件名称正确不能弥补起算事件错误。

80270b5dedd898f7.en: The draft response correctly names Д-2, but calculates the period from the receipt for Д-1.
80270b5dedd898f7.zh: 回复草案正确写明Д-2，却按Д-1回执计算期限。

ce0000dd885de17a.en: Correct the calculation basis to the submission date of Д-2 and recheck the response.
ce0000dd885de17a.zh: 将计算依据改为Д-2提交日期，并重新核查回复。

d59dc808f16fec9c.en: Leave it because both returns belong to the same person.
d59dc808f16fec9c.zh: 因两份申报属于同一个人，就不修改。

dadc33c4c9a5e793.en: Retroactively change the date on the receipt for Д-1.

350d2aa8c5adf560.en: Paragraph 2 of Article 88 of the Russian Tax Code establishes the general three-month review period for an ordinary return. Under paragraph 9.1, submitting an amended return before the previous review ends terminates that review and starts review of the amended return. Explanations and supporting documents under paragraphs 3–5 are not in themselves an amended return. An application under paragraph 2 of Article 221.1 has a 30-calendar-day period; the law permits a special extension under the relevant conditions. Completion of review is not automatically the date a refund is credited.
350d2aa8c5adf560.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第88条第2款规定普通申报核查的一般期限为三个月。根据第9.1款，在此前核查结束前提交更正申报，将终止该核查并启动对更正申报的核查。第3–5款所述说明及证明文件本身不属于更正申报。第221.1条第2款申请的期限为30个自然日；法律允许符合相应条件时特别延长。核查结束日期并不自动等于退税到账日期。

f2cc5435e5b6fcb6.en: Apply paragraph 9.1 of Article 88 when an amended return is submitted before review ends.
f2cc5435e5b6fcb6.zh: 核查结束前提交更正申报时，适用第88条第9.1款。

7ef40c3e87b3f36b.zh: 收到任何说明后都重新开始核查。

ff0b6c0247ff73f0.en: Count three months from contacting the bank.
ff0b6c0247ff73f0.zh: 从联系银行时起算三个月。

5a2558a9f9528b5d.en: Find the rule: Desk tax review—return, amendment and explanations. Give the instrument's identifying details and article, then select the applicable provision.
5a2558a9f9528b5d.zh: 查找规定：税务案头核查——申报、更正及说明。填写法律文件信息及条文，再选择适用规定。

328f95fbc505a03e.en: It has been almost three months since my first return. But later I changed the amount and filed an amended one. Count from the first anyway.
328f95fbc505a03e.zh: 第一份申报提交快满三个月了。不过后来我改了金额，又提交更正申报。还是请从第一份算吧。

4f72d27974e040cf.en: Desk review of an amended return under Article 88 of the Russian Tax Code.
4f72d27974e040cf.zh: 依据俄罗斯税法典第88条核查更正申报。

622d9e881cfdf54e.en: A general response under 59-ФЗ instead of determining the tax-review period.
622d9e881cfdf54e.zh: 用59-ФЗ一般回复代替确定税务核查期限。

36faf58865be40a6.en: Thirty-day review of a simplified application instead of an ordinary return.
36faf58865be40a6.zh: 用简化申请的三十日核查代替普通申报核查。

c340aa1a77cfdf74.en: When was the original return submitted?

f2a9b730c751e3cd.en: The receipt dated {{amended}} confirms an amended return specifically, not an explanation.
f2a9b730c751e3cd.zh: {{amended}}的回执确认提交的是更正申报，而非说明。

82f7b4f113be4861.en: A new return differs from explanations.

d8fdf195cefa2938.en: No, the amended return arrived before it ended.
d8fdf195cefa2938.zh: 没有，更正申报在结束前已收到。

57598329e228a054.en: The special procedure for terminating the previous review applies.
57598329e228a054.zh: 适用终止此前核查的专门程序。

27e97d8c4d6e0472.en: No; the reception letter was submitted later, on {{received}}.
27e97d8c4d6e0472.zh: 没有；给接待处的信是后来于{{received}}提交的。

491546e9823c79cb.en: Receipt of an ordinary letter does not start a new review period.
491546e9823c79cb.zh: 收到普通信件不会启动新的核查期限。

1a17a9463eafe0b3.en: Were there other changes after the amendment?
1a17a9463eafe0b3.zh: 更正之后还有其他变化吗？

0795228978f4ba92.zh: 纳税人说明材料编制专员

51f65744a41968f6.en: The tax authority conducting the relevant review.
51f65744a41968f6.zh: 开展相应核查的税务机关。

a2ab8afc587a3354.en: The bank as the authority setting the desk-review period.
a2ab8afc587a3354.zh: 将银行当作确定税务案头核查期限的机关。

ef45fc3907157c37.en: The MFC as the authority recalculating a tax deduction.
ef45fc3907157c37.zh: 将MFC当作重新计算税收扣除的机关。

77dbc81952068ecc.en: Paragraph 9.1 of Article 88 applies to the amended return; explanations alone are not a new return.
77dbc81952068ecc.zh: 更正申报适用第88条第9.1款；说明本身并非新申报。

bcc2a92e837e97c1.en: An amended return and explanations about the earlier return always restart review in the same way.
bcc2a92e837e97c1.zh: 更正申报与对原申报的说明，始终以同样方式重新启动核查。

6d9a0578987424fa.en: Establish the return type and whether amendments exist
6d9a0578987424fa.zh: 确定申报类型及是否存在更正

34295a413ce910e1.en: Check its submission date on the receipt
34295a413ce910e1.zh: 根据回执核查提交日期

7f1725182548fd4b.en: Calculate the end in months, then check for a non-working final day
7f1725182548fd4b.zh: 按月计算结束日，再核查最后一天是否非工作日

5c55d4a2303ca842.en: Explain the difference between review completion and refund without unsupported promises
5c55d4a2303ca842.zh: 解释核查结束与退税的区别，不作无据承诺

eaa9ce313481e095.en: Match the review-completion notification to this return
eaa9ce313481e095.zh: 核对核查结束通知是否针对该申报

b6df8e3d936b42ce.en: Guarantee a credit date without checking the separate procedure
b6df8e3d936b42ce.zh: 未核查独立程序就保证到账日期

453289103498af00.en: Replace three months with ninety days

b3d129ce754a6e2a.en: The conditions apply the general three-month period to an ordinary original 3-NDFL return without amendments. Calculation follows Article 6.1 of the Russian Tax Code. The required date is review completion, not a refund day. This is neither a VAT return nor the simplified deduction procedure.
b3d129ce754a6e2a.zh: 题目对未经更正的普通原始3-NDFL申报适用一般三个月期限，按俄罗斯税法典第6.1条计算。要求核查结束日期，而非退税日期。它既不是增值税申报，也不是简化扣除程序。

af6e975dcb70ceaa.en: Only the specified ordinary review. Simplified deductions, VAT, amended returns and refund periods are not calculated here.
af6e975dcb70ceaa.zh: 仅计算指定的普通核查。本题不计算简化扣除、增值税、更正申报及退税期限。

8ba920b13bd2683a.en: Russian Tax Code, Article 88, paragraph 2; Article 6.1, paragraphs 2, 5, 7.
8ba920b13bd2683a.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第88条第2款；第6.1条第2、5、7款。

09fef86dba2a5d64.en: Final day of an ordinary desk tax review
09fef86dba2a5d64.zh: 普通税务案头核查的最后一天

3f74e70c9f4b81cd.en: An ordinary original 3-NDFL return was submitted on {{declaration}}. There are no amended returns. Calculate the latest completion of the general desk review, not the refund.
3f74e70c9f4b81cd.zh: 普通原始3-NDFL申报于{{declaration}}提交，无更正申报。计算一般案头核查最迟结束时间，而非退税时间。

877819a579e622a5.en: The submission was received on {{received}} and registered on {{registered}}. It is not a new return and does not restart review.
877819a579e622a5.zh: 来函于{{received}}收到，{{registered}}登记。它不是新申报，不会重新启动核查。

bcd95976b3beec48.en: The three-month review period is linked to filing the return; it cannot be replaced with 90 days or the date of a later letter.
bcd95976b3beec48.zh: 三个月核查期限与提交申报相关，不能替换为90天或后续信件日期。

e16b72e12cf12602.en: Any new letter restarts three months.
e16b72e12cf12602.zh: 任何新信件都会重新起算三个月。

cbc842dbd5256eb6.en: 90 days always equal three calendar months.

eb93dd373bab7191.en: The inspectorate reports that review is complete. The applicant treats this as confirmation that the transfer has already occurred.
eb93dd373bab7191.zh: 税务分局告知核查已结束。申请人认为这证明款项已经转出。

49f3fcad7c7b3502.en: Check separate refund information; completing review does not prove credit to the account.
49f3fcad7c7b3502.zh: 另行核查退税信息；核查结束不能证明账户到账。

1f8ad64cb967e813.en: Say the money has already been received.

619350d52fa08cce.en: Start a new review because of a transfer question.
619350d52fa08cce.zh: 因询问转账就启动新核查。

061cde4ca2542f11.en: Paragraph 2 of Article 88 of the Russian Tax Code gives the specified ordinary desk review a three-month period. Article 6.1 describes periods in months, the corresponding date and the end in a month lacking that date. Three calendar months are not replaced by 90 days. This task does not extend the general period to VAT or simplified deductions and does not determine a refund date.
061cde4ca2542f11.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第88条第2款规定，所述普通案头核查期限为三个月。第6.1条规定按月计算、对应日期及最后月份没有该日期时的处理。三个日历月不能替换为90天。本题不将一般期限扩展至增值税或简化扣除，也不确定退税日期。

bf3065e9b5844173.en: Find the general period for an ordinary desk review of a tax return.
bf3065e9b5844173.zh: 查找普通申报案头核查的一般期限。

16b1c226ee2957f3.en: I filed an ordinary 3-NDFL return for a deduction. I counted 90 days in the app, but the inspectorate gave a different date. My reception letter was even later—which date should count?
16b1c226ee2957f3.zh: 我为申请扣除提交了普通3-NDFL申报。应用里数了90天，税务分局却说是另一个日期。给接待处的信更晚，到底从哪天算？

705ffffa1b14c018.en: Ordinary desk review of an original return
705ffffa1b14c018.zh: 原始申报的普通案头核查

5dddaa0c217d3dd8.en: Simplified deduction procedure without a return
5dddaa0c217d3dd8.zh: 无需申报表的简化扣除程序

3aa109b75858ff1b.en: An ordinary 30-day response instead of the review period
3aa109b75858ff1b.zh: 用普通30日回复代替核查期限

e40439d93300b48e.en: An original ordinary 3-NDFL return. Not the simplified procedure or VAT.
e40439d93300b48e.zh: 原始普通3-NDFL申报，不是简化程序或增值税。

7f322de89c8375b5.en: The general three-month review period applies in this case.
7f322de89c8375b5.zh: 本案适用一般三个月核查期限。

62137ffd703a586c.en: The return date differs from the later letter's date.
62137ffd703a586c.zh: 申报日期不同于后续信件日期。

95a5a16538b1f773.en: Is there a receipt confirming submission of the return?

5691672945c5a5c8.en: No. This episode has no conditions altering the running of the period.
5691672945c5a5c8.zh: 没有，本情境不存在改变期限运行的条件。

69024d44e1d7e227.en: Do not invent a review restart.
69024d44e1d7e227.zh: 不要虚构核查重新启动。

f2a040e15da32f93.en: The final desk-review day, not crediting of money to the account.
f2a040e15da32f93.zh: 案头核查的最后一天，而非账户到账。

143489d475fc9fef.en: Review and refund are separate events.
143489d475fc9fef.zh: 核查与退税是不同事件。

4600cdfba1252ee7.en: Explains the ordinary desk-review deadline and checks receipt facts. Does not promise a refund by review completion.
4600cdfba1252ee7.zh: 解释普通案头核查的最长期限，并核查收件事实。不承诺核查结束时退税。

88afb92b355dd300.en: Apply the general Article 88 period and month calculation under Article 6.1 of the Russian Tax Code, separating review from refund.
88afb92b355dd300.zh: 适用俄罗斯税法典第88条一般期限及第6.1条按月计算规则，区分核查与退税。

8d215f20d35a2432.en: Count three months from registration of the reception letter.
8d215f20d35a2432.zh: 从接待处信件登记日起算三个月。

0f8c0350197796a4.en: Three months is not ninety days

f6a684629e3c650a.en: Use the corresponding date in the final month, or that month's last day if there is no such date.
f6a684629e3c650a.zh: 采用最后月份的对应日期；没有该日期时采用该月最后一天。

86b6922ac58a54b0.en: Assistant: “A calendar month is always 30 days.”
86b6922ac58a54b0.zh: 助手：“日历上的一个月永远是30天。”

b7ac3642f8de157a.en: Compare the later submission's type with the tax return receipt.
b7ac3642f8de157a.zh: 核对后续提交类型与申报回执。

a9e942445a0fdc7d.en: Establish that the verified materials contain no amended return.
a9e942445a0fdc7d.zh: 确认核实后的材料中没有更正申报。

bec1774a07ba8b9b.en: Prepare calculation from the original return and correct the unjustified new starting point.
bec1774a07ba8b9b.zh: 按原始申报准备计算，并纠正无依据的新起算。

131b7d1dc787e045.en: Promise neither automatic deduction approval nor a date for receipt of money.
131b7d1dc787e045.zh: 既不承诺自动批准扣除，也不承诺到账日期。

ce627c5056478326.en: Check the final response against the original date and correct tax period.
ce627c5056478326.zh: 核对最终回复采用的原始日期及正确纳税期间。

7a17c1a439e33444.en: Exclude all explanations from the file because they are not a return.
7a17c1a439e33444.zh: 因说明不是申报表，就将全部说明排除出案卷。

b1d1e2527289f18a.en: Guarantee approval of the amount solely because explanations were sent on time.
b1d1e2527289f18a.zh: 仅因按时发送说明就保证批准金额。

6580f31b604dfed7.en: All participants and documents are fictional. An ordinary original 3-NDFL return was accepted; there is no amended return. The attached explanations do not change the return or include another one. The conditions contain no special grounds for other periods. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. Calculate completion of the original return's desk review, not the letter-response period.
6580f31b604dfed7.zh: 所有参与者和文件均为虚构。普通原始3-NDFL申报已受理，没有更正申报。所附说明不改变申报，也不含另一份申报。条件中没有适用其他期限的特别依据。您准备材料和行动方案，不代替有权人员决定。计算原始申报案头核查的结束时间，而非信件回复期限。

6e3a55fb195fab9d.en: Ordinary original 3-NDFL; no amended return was submitted. Additional explanations do not restart the period.
6e3a55fb195fab9d.zh: 普通原始3-NDFL；未提交更正申报。补充说明不会重新起算期限。

1f8ab4e30eb7b8bb.en: Ordinary original 3-NDFL; no amended return was submitted. Additional explanations do not restart the period. This exercise's calculation profile: from the day after the event; a non-working end date moves forward; the federal five-day working week.
1f8ab4e30eb7b8bb.zh: 普通原始3-NDFL；未提交更正申报。补充说明不会重新起算期限。本题计算规则：从事件次日起算；非工作日截止向后顺延；采用联邦每周五天工作制。

82cbab2c215cef79.en: Russian Tax Code, Article 88, paragraphs 2–5; Article 6.1
82cbab2c215cef79.zh: 俄罗斯税法典第88条第2–5款；第6.1条

601e43ed83a8c222.en: Final review day for the original return
601e43ed83a8c222.zh: 原始申报核查的最后一天

2e7ab85904c250cf.en: In the adjacent story, an amended return really was submitted. Here there are only explanations, so the consequence for the starting date differs.
2e7ab85904c250cf.zh: 相邻故事确实提交了更正申报。本案只有说明，因此对起算日期的影响不同。

a58c628a206ff535.en: Received on {{explanation}} as explanations with attachments concerning the same return. There is no receipt for a new return; the return's figures did not change.
a58c628a206ff535.zh: 于{{explanation}}收到，类型为针对同一申报的说明及附件。没有新申报受理回执，申报数值未改变。

9ddf62be8c77734b.en: The draft's author proposes a new three-month period after any file received; no legal basis is cited.
9ddf62be8c77734b.zh: 草案作者建议收到任何文件后都重新计算三个月，未援引法律依据。

f77d001f873a0228.en: The original ordinary 3-NDFL return was submitted on {{declaration}}. No amended returns have been received.
f77d001f873a0228.zh: 原始普通3-NDFL申报于{{declaration}}提交，未收到更正申报。

4a33b025d7ea78e6.en: The return was submitted {{declaration}}; explanations {{explanation}}. The letter was received {{received}} and registered {{registered}}.
4a33b025d7ea78e6.zh: 申报于{{declaration}}提交，说明于{{explanation}}提交。信件于{{received}}收到、{{registered}}登记。

b3300e75ec0d8903.en: Explanations are not an amended return; a new three-month count from them is unsupported. In the adjacent story, an amended return really was submitted. Here there are only explanations, so the consequence for the starting date differs.
b3300e75ec0d8903.zh: 说明不是更正申报，没有依据据此重新计算三个月。相邻故事确实提交了更正申报。本案只有说明，因此对起算日期的影响不同。

b2806fd301b9719e.en: Explanations are not an amended return; a new three-month count from them is unsupported.
b2806fd301b9719e.zh: 说明不是更正申报，没有依据据此重新计算三个月。

81884ab7e929abb5.en: Every taxpayer file starts a new review.
81884ab7e929abb5.zh: 纳税人每提交一个文件都会启动新核查。

e7280cc90f3613a8.en: After explanations, review must end immediately regardless of the original period.
e7280cc90f3613a8.zh: 提交说明后，不论原期限如何，核查都必须立即结束。

1c5d0b62acca5ed1.en: Document checking includes the period and identifier.
1c5d0b62acca5ed1.zh: 文件核查包括期间及标识。

ab7e36a91dd5af04.en: A notification of review results arrived, but it concerns another tax period.
ab7e36a91dd5af04.zh: 收到核查结果通知，但纳税期间不同。

af31cb6a62d5a729.en: Compare the period and request a response for Д-3; do not close the matter with another result.
af31cb6a62d5a729.zh: 核对期间并要求对Д-3回复，不用其他结果结案。

6c0a08ac0a4c2ca3.en: Treat any review result as a decision on the required return.
6c0a08ac0a4c2ca3.zh: 将任何核查结果都视为对目标申报的决定。

a42a28727d3b3d8e.en: Change the return's period to match the notification received.
a42a28727d3b3d8e.zh: 修改申报期间以匹配收到的通知。

047ef1e758547eb8.en: Distinguish explanations under Article 88 from an amended return under paragraph 9.1.
047ef1e758547eb8.zh: 区分第88条说明与第9.1款更正申报。

c20efd2c8e01c4b0.en: Treat any addition as another return.
c20efd2c8e01c4b0.zh: 将任何补充都视为再次申报。

e6f6e604f969d957.en: Treat the inspectorate's request as an unconditional refusal of the deduction.
e6f6e604f969d957.zh: 将税务分局的请求视为无条件拒绝扣除。

cb9237b05a972fbb.en: I sent explanations and a supporting scan. A statement says I now have to wait another three months. Is that really correct?
cb9237b05a972fbb.zh: 我提交了说明和证明扫描件。说明函却写现在又要等三个月，确实如此吗？

49a14797f5395e59.en: Desk review of the original return taking explanations into account.
49a14797f5395e59.zh: 在考虑说明的情况下核查原始申报。

fceace6b3f054a9b.en: A new review of an amended return absent from the case.
fceace6b3f054a9b.zh: 对案卷中不存在的更正申报启动新核查。

0555d0013aa8559c.en: Thirty-day review of a simplified application instead of the return.
0555d0013aa8559c.zh: 用简化申请三十日审查代替申报核查。

f946311baf671530.zh: 写的是“说明及证明文件”，不是“更正申报表”。

c11f7565a644c45d.en: The type of material submitted matters.
c11f7565a644c45d.zh: 提交材料的类型很重要。

b7d93619e065aa33.en: What type is listed for the later submission?
b7d93619e065aa33.zh: 后续提交列明什么类型？

030909cee5e8231c.en: No, I explained amounts already stated.
030909cee5e8231c.zh: 没有，我只是解释已经填报的金额。

26752d74daa589bc.en: What date appears on the return receipt?
26752d74daa589bc.zh: 申报回执上的日期是什么？

b804b28a59d22b1b.en: In the draft statement; no legal basis was given there.
b804b28a59d22b1b.zh: 出现在说明函草案中，未列法律依据。

66ce17a1c5e47234.en: The assumption in the statement requires checking.
66ce17a1c5e47234.zh: 说明函中的假设需要核查。

513e636d90238585.en: Where did the new waiting date appear?
513e636d90238585.zh: 新的等候日期出现在哪里？

e4d508b93b30e8e1.en: The tax authority unit reviewing the return and explanations.
e4d508b93b30e8e1.zh: 核查申报和说明的税务机关部门。

8a2ef62efbfa11b9.en: The email operator as the authority determining the period.
8a2ef62efbfa11b9.zh: 将电子邮件运营商当作确定期限的机关。

678635035c83ebcd.en: The seller of a supporting document instead of the tax authority.
678635035c83ebcd.zh: 用证明文件销售者代替税务机关。

aff42dbe7cc66816.en: Explanations are not a new return

19aabc126cf51581.en: Substantive work with explanations is not a new event of filing a return.
19aabc126cf51581.zh: 对说明的实质审查不等于新的申报提交事件。

03aec8cec98545d4.en: Explanations are considered during review but do not in themselves become an amended return.
03aec8cec98545d4.zh: 说明在核查中予以考虑，但本身不会变成更正申报。

ae0374c7873f34ab.en: Compare draft status with the submission receipt.
ae0374c7873f34ab.zh: 核对草稿状态及提交回执。

db6c6be2895577d7.en: Establish the applicable simplified procedure and absence of an extension.
db6c6be2895577d7.zh: 确定适用简化程序且未延期。

83e7bdf3473a6e4d.en: Prepare calculation from the submitted application's date.
83e7bdf3473a6e4d.zh: 从已提交申请日期起准备计算。

2b646c6dfeff83a8.en: Do not promise automatic payment on the final review day.
2b646c6dfeff83a8.zh: 不承诺核查最后一天自动付款。

976c095f0e011228.en: Check the result specifically for application У-4 and the next step explained.
976c095f0e011228.zh: 核查结果是否具体针对申请У-4，以及是否说明下一步。

06851432d104cc5d.en: Start the period from the first display of an unsigned draft.
06851432d104cc5d.zh: 从未签署草稿首次显示之日起算期限。

42622106144210dc.en: Declare the full deduction approved merely because a form appeared.
42622106144210dc.zh: 仅因表单出现就宣布全部扣除金额获批。

ef1709848a535a0d.en: All participants and documents are fictional. Application of the simplified procedure under Article 221.1 of the Russian Tax Code is established. An admissible application is signed and submitted, with sufficient information. There is no decision to extend review, and no exceptions to the standard period apply. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. Calculate the thirty-day review of the submitted application; no separate money-transfer period is calculated.
ef1709848a535a0d.zh: 所有参与者和文件均为虚构。已确定适用俄罗斯税法典第221.1条简化程序。适当申请已签署并提交，信息充分。没有延长核查的决定，也不适用标准期限的例外。您准备材料和行动方案，不代替有权人员决定。计算已提交申请的三十日核查期限，不另算转账期限。

094ba963b9463385.en: A submitted application under the simplified procedure. No extension or special exceptions.
094ba963b9463385.zh: 按简化程序已提交的申请，无延期或特别例外。
